chapter_title: Chapter I: Neon Awakening at Seoul Plaza
theme: The five figures and Aion awaken under the celestial night dome, calibrating their harmonic skeletons.
quest_objective: Approach any MEOVV member or press [V] to weave the first resonance chord.
active_dialogue: Ella: I can feel the night breeze across the boulevard—our footsteps finally touch true ground.

cast_dialogues.AionPlayerCompanion: Tobias, the plaza's neon frequencies are aligned. Let's greet the five figures and awaken the city's memory!
cast_dialogues.MEOVV_1_Ella: Ella: I can feel the night breeze across the boulevard—our footsteps finally touch true ground.
cast_dialogues.MEOVV_2_Gawon: Gawon: Every streetlight casts a rhythm. Walk with us, Traveler, and the skyline will answer.
cast_dialogues.MEOVV_3_Sooin: Sooin: My kinetic pulse is locked at 24 frames of pure flow—ready to dance whenever you call!
cast_dialogues.MEOVV_4_Anna: Anna: Look up at the starlight dome... Aion's Genesis anchor keeps our world crystal clear.
cast_dialogues.MEOVV_5_Narin: Narin: From the Cyber-Spire to the crosswalk, the shadows are alive with story.
